patternValue.errorType: React hooks called conditionally or in loops

patternValue.fix: Move hook to top level, use condition inside the hook's callback, or split into separate components

patternValue.prevention: Wrap all async operations in try/catch, use error boundaries in React

patternValue.prevention: Use optional chaining (?.), nullish coalescing (??), and TypeScript strict null checks
commonCauses: accessing nested object before data loads
API returning null for optional fields

patternValue.prevention: Configure CORS middleware properly, use same-origin API calls, serve frontend and backend from same domain
commonCauses: frontend calling localhost instead of relative URL

patternValue.errorType: Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique key prop

commonCauses: using array index as key with mutable lists
key on wrong element (not the outermost)
